snippet.title: Sonic's Fun and Easy Adventure
snippet.description:
This video showcases Sonic's Fun and Easy Adventure, a Sonic rom hack which purposly implements some of the most annoying and frustrating elements from the classic Sonic games. Made by Novedicus, BinBowie & VAdaPEGA.
#SonicHacks #SonicTheHedgehog
